protocol.scope: New A1 development families; not independent, blind, or a replacement of historical121
protocol.failure_policy: Ordinary per-item failures continue. One answer format repair in each arm. Query has no retry. All planned members remain.
protocol.phases: One shared query generation, actual fixed retrieval, then three direct full-native-choice arms. No second adjudication.
protocol.tool_policy: Two queries each BM25 per-corpus32 plus adopted MedCPT top8; interleave, deduplicate normalized full content, exclude exact full-content repeats from original context, keep at most8 added chunks. Complete original materials retained.
protocol.common_cost: B/query/retrieval shared source cost retained once physically, attributed per method separately. Same caps are not equal realized expense.
protocol.optional_search_policy: Query failures remain failures. All three answer arms independently run on the complete original input when no valid query exists; target=null, queries=[], additional_evidence=[]. B-invalid inputs remain unavailable. No failed-query prefix recovery, query retry or post-hoc native rescue.
protocol.evidence_ablation: No-new-evidence arm uses the same support-expert system as main; ordinary reanswer receives the same evidence and user payload as main.
